compiled_state.title: As a reconciler operator, I want reconcile.py to orchestrate fetch->diff->apply with mode flag, phase-gate lockfile, and GHA concurrency
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: reconcile.py orchestrator wiring fetcher (draft-3) -> invariants (draft-6) -> differ (draft-1) -> applier (draft-2) dispatching all mutation classes including probe (draft-4) and status-aware update (draft-5). Mode flag {dry-run | bootstrap-strict | bootstrap-throttle | live}. Tickets-branch advisory .reconciler-pass-lock + .reconciler-phase-gate lockfile. GHA concurrency: {group: reconcile-bridge, cancel-in-progress: false}.
**Why**: synthetic-drift healing (sc-9) requires the orchestrator runnable end-to-end against live DIG.
**Scope**:
- IN: reconcile.py, mode flag with strict allow-list, .reconciler-pass-lock advisory, .reconciler-phase-gate lockfile, GHA concurrency wiring
- OUT: Cron scheduling changes (continues from 3a03), webhook listeners, multi-project orchestration

## Done Definitions

- tests/drift_injection/inject-and-heal.sh against live DIG with --mode=orphan, --mode=mislabel, --mode=missing-prop each heals within 1 pass and bridge-fsck exits 0 after each; one test invocation per mode ← Satisfies: sc-9
- An invalid --mode=<unknown> value causes reconcile.py to exit non-zero before any fetcher call, with an error naming the allowed mode set ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-9
- When two reconcile.py invocations start concurrently against the same tickets branch, the second invocation observes the .reconciler-pass-lock advisory and exits non-zero without fetching ← Satisfies: sc-9
- Removing .reconciler-phase-gate is required to advance from bootstrap-strict to bootstrap-throttle; a test asserts the orchestrator refuses the transition while the gate is present ← Satisfies: sc-9
- Orchestrator dispatches every applier leaf in the draft-1 taxonomy without skipping probe (draft-4) or status (draft-5); smoke test runs end-to-end against a fixture covering all 9 leaves ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Security] The pass-lock and phase-gate are advisory tickets-branch files, not OS locks. Document that operators must not bypass them by editing the tickets branch directly.
- [Reliability] The mode flag is the central rollout-safety knob; resist the temptation to add a --force override.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
